chars.DJ: DJ: a Moroccan man around 30, short faded black hair, trimmed black beard, wearing a black bomber jacket over a plain white t-shirt, thin silver chain, black jeans
chars.SWEDE: SWEDE: a young Swedish woman, long straight platinum-blonde hair, pale skin, wearing an oversized mint-green hoodie, light-blue mom jeans, white sneakers
chars.MUSTACHE: MUSTACHE: a slim, ordinary-looking man with a thick dark mustache and slicked-back hair, wearing a shiny open-collar burgundy silk shirt and a gold chain

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca airport arrivals hall: SWEDE walks out of the arrivals gate pulling a suitcase, mid-step, looking around; seen from where DJ stands waiting, head-to-waist framing on SWEDE, her face visible; DJ only partly visible from behind at the edge. Cartoon, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca airport arrivals hall: DJ holds out a big bouquet of red roses with both hands, wide hopeful smile, slightly nervous, head-to-waist. Cartoon, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca Corniche at sunset by the ocean: DJ walks beside SWEDE, pointing excitedly at the view while talking, she holds the roses and looks around. Cartoon, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: a fancy Casablanca restaurant table: SWEDE sits with a flat, bored expression, scrolling her phone, while DJ across the table leans in trying hard to impress her, worried face. Cartoon, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: night, a small Casablanca bedroom: DJ sitting on the edge of his bed, staring at his phone screen with narrowed suspicious eyes, face lit by the phone, scrolling. Cartoon, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: a selfie-style holiday photo look: SWEDE laughing with her arm around MUSTACHE at a beach bar, both relaxed and happy. Cartoon, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: crowded nightclub dance floor with colorful lights: SWEDE dances close with MUSTACHE, matching his steps, both smiling. Cartoon, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: bar counter in a nightclub: MUSTACHE leans on the bar holding a glass, his shiny burgundy silk shirt open at the collar, smug confident smile, head-to-waist. Cartoon, no text.
